title: Add the read-only bee models show verb returning the raw role table
action: New verb `bee models show [--runtime claude|codex|opencode] --json` (new `models` group): read-only; prints the RAW models.<runtime> table from .bee/config.json — every slot shape verbatim, description intact — plus the runtime's built-in defaults for roles the config does not name, each row marked source: configured|default. No runtime flag = every runtime the config or defaults know. Follow the `work show` verb end to end as the wiring pattern: catalog entry with help text teaching that descriptions live here and agents read this verb instead of parsing config.json, router wiring, handler module verbs/models_group.rs, unit tests. Regenerate generated/registry_payload.json by whatever mechanism the repo uses for catalog changes (find it; bee dev regen runs at minimum). The handler must NOT call normalize_models for the table it prints (normalize strips description by design — read the raw config JSON).

truths: bee models show --json on a config with a described role prints that slot verbatim including description
A role only the built-in defaults know appears with source default
The verb never mutates anything and resolution/guard/dispatch code paths are untouched

verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee models_group — green with the new tests named in the output; bee dev regen green; bee dev release-manifest --check green
notes: PBI p-0a5e6c44 CoS 1. Router group list in router.rs and catalog.rs both need the new group; check how registry_payload.json is generated (build step or dev regen) and run it inside this cell.
